reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 editorial review of all 26 original low-typing questions: solved complete German sentences, evaluated each offered distractor, answer keys, grammatical forms, bilingual feedback and distinct contexts. Four revisions clarified entgangen, erforderlich, erfolgsversprechend and fehlerhaft. Thirteen sources authored, six deferred for doubtful CEFR, register or overlap, and regional färbig mapped as duplicate of farbig without adding a new target. Corrected major inherited error: entgeltlich means paid, while source gloss and example described unentgeltlich (unpaid). Also corrected eventuality, familiär and entgangen senses and avoided archaic literary quotations. All target reviews pending, publicationApproved=false. Structural CI is not independent linguistic certification or rights clearance.
